reason: SACPS covariance changes CAPL risk-objective geometry while CAPL cap/turnover feasible set is fixed; distinct from V2P039 covariance-coupled allocation and V2P040 turnover-feasible-set contraction.

BPISD emits binary-state posterior/signal-channel policies; SACPS requires a multivariate observation matrix plus an explicit covariance-support mask. No source contract maps the persuasion channel into covariance observations/support without inventing a new semantic adapter.

ACRA is a shared-budget time/frequency resolution allocation engine. Adding SACPS covariance coupling to that allocation is the same deep covariance-coupled allocation operator already executable as V2P039 SCCATF; a domain shell rewrite would be a family variant, not a new family.

SACPS covariance revises CSID evidence-family equivalence/common-mode partition, changing multiplicative coverage and portfolio selection. This changes the independence representation itself, not merely adding a covariance penalty to an allocation objective.

CCVC emits viability certificates/filtered controls; SACPS estimates covariance from repeated multivariate observations and a support mask. The current contracts expose no theorem-preserving mapping from a viability certificate/control into covariance samples/support.

CAPL emits a feature-conditioned asset-allocation policy; ACRA consumes decision-region time/frequency importance and resolution-option error/cost tables. Current source contracts do not turn a portfolio action into ACRA measurement-resolution loss parameters without an external model.

SCCRT consumes catalyst/feed/regeneration state parameters, not covariance-dependent observations or risk decisions. Injecting SACPS would require an unprovided stochastic reaction/support semantics rather than composing current executable contracts.

MIFF returns a cut set/contamination analysis over module-flow graphs; DSBC requires posterior belief vectors plus hidden-state/action utilities. A firewall could protect a belief-producing pipeline, but the present sources do not expose the posterior reconstruction needed after a cut, so a direct product would be a wrapper around an invented adapter.

DHCC returns ridge-calibrated hedge coefficients and realized hedge loss; DSBC compresses posterior beliefs under a state-action utility matrix. No current source contract converts hedge-covariance calibration into posterior beliefs/utilities.
